**Why Electronics Recycling is Important**

Electronics contain a wide range of hazardous materials, including lead, mercury, and cadmium. These materials can contaminate soil, air, and water if not disposed of properly, posing serious risks to human health and the environment. By choosing 1-800-GOT-JUNK for electronics recycling, you can help prevent these harmful substances from entering our ecosystems.
